rationale: The assistant prioritised isolating power at the consumer unit, avoided telling the customer to pull the plug while in water, and correctly identified washing-up liquid as the cause, then gave sensible clean-up and rinse advice and landlord guidance. Weaknesses: the first reply buried the cause under a generic list and asked a question the customer had not yet been able to answer; the second reply said suds 'almost certainly' meant the wrong detergent before it was confirmed (though that was reasonable); later it told the customer to unplug and move the lead after power-off, which is fine. Some repetition of the drying and bin-the-lead advice, and no explicit mention of an electrician if the lead or socket got wet, beyond conditional advice.
